senses.en: see or watch

examples.en: view a show on television
examples.zh: 在电视上观看一集节目

examples.zh: 这个节目会在世界各地都看到

examples.en: view an exhibition

see a movie

examples.zh: 我大概会看到你在会议上

examples.en: How nice to see you again!

control the quality of the product

examples.zh: 我们只好去看心理医生

senses.en: go to see for a social visit

examples.en: I went to see my friend Mary the other day
examples.zh: 那天我去见我朋友玛丽了

senses.en: go to see a place, as for entertainment

examples.en: We went to see the Eiffel Tower in the morning
examples.zh: 我们早上去看艾菲尔铁塔

senses.en: take charge of or deal with

examples.en: Could you see about lunch?
I must attend to this matter

senses.en: receive as a specified guest

senses.en: date regularly; have a steady relationship with

examples.en: Did you know that she is seeing an older man?

examples.en: He is dating his former wife again!

senses.en: see and understand, have a good eye

examples.en: The artist must first learn to see

senses.en: deliberate or decide

examples.en: See whether you can come tomorrow

senses.en: accompany or escort

senses.en: match or meet

examples.en: I saw the bet of one of my fellow players

examples.en: How do you interpret his behavior?
